component.name: StorVerity
component.summary: Verify removable storage integrity and detect fake capacity

description.p: StorVerity is a Linux-first verification utility for USB drives, SD cards and other removable storage. It provides non-destructive filesystem verification and a guarded raw capacity probe for detecting fraudulent or unreliable media.
The raw capacity probe writes directly to selected storage and can cause data loss. StorVerity blocks unsafe targets and requires explicit per-run confirmation.
